note: Iowa DNR state park in wooded hills SW of Algona, with a 1920s day-use lodge. A small, non-modern campground in the woods. No daily Iowa park-entry fee. --Claude
summary: Hookups 30 A (no sewer), 16 sites to 31 ft with pull-throughs, facilities (pit toilet, water, no showers or flush toilets), season Apr 15 - Nov 15 and booking (100% reservable, 3-month window, 10 pm day-of cutoff) confirmed from DNR/ReserveAmerica; fees unchanged (match RA: $10/$12 non-electric, $18/$20 electric). Not waterfront confirmed. PIN ~480 m off. Note trimmed.
flags: PIN: stored 43.0517,-94.2542 is ~480 m WNW of the campground. Correct to 43.0502,-94.2486, the centroid of ReserveAmerica's 16 per-site GIS points.
PHONE: none stored. The DNR page sends callers to the Pilot Knob park manager, (641) 581-4835. apply.py does not write phone.

FIT: sites run 20-31 ft. Non-electric 14 (26 ft) and 15 (24 ft) fit a 23-ft rig, so the $10/$12 non-electric base stands, though only just. 10 of 13 electric sites list 23 ft or more, with 09-11 at 20 ft. A 23-ft rig fits, but tightly.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. RA tags every site 'Near Water - no', and the imagery shows unbroken woods around the loop.
